title: FloorQi Floorplan
description: Contract between extraction, 3D and scoring. Coordinates are metres; origin is the top-left of the plan image; +x is right, +y is down (image convention). Rooms are axis-aligned rectangles; we can extend to polygons later.

image_px.description: [width, height] of the source image, used to overlay boxes on it

px_per_m.description: Scale derived from printed room dimensions

north_deg.description: Compass bearing that 'up' on the plan points to (0 = up is north, 90 = up is east). null if the plan has no north arrow; the UI can ask the user.

outline.description: Apartment footprint polygon, clockwise, [[x,y],...]. Used for the Bagua grid and missing-corner checks.

dims_text.description: Printed dimensions, verbatim, e.g. "3.45m x 2.80m (11'4" x 9'2")"

axis.description: Orientation of the wall the opening sits in: h = horizontal wall, v = vertical wall

rooms.description: Room ids on either side. Use 'outside' for the exterior or common corridor.
